governance_note: Document sector classification, aggregation level, geography, table year, and source.
Record transaction sources, output denominators, price basis, domestic/import treatment, and matrix orientation.
Check invertibility, numerical stability, residuals, nonnegative outputs, and economic plausibility.
Estimate matrix conditioning and test sensitivity to coefficient perturbations.
Define output, value-added, employment, emissions, or other multiplier type and avoid welfare overclaims.
Document scenario source, units, timing, price basis, affected sectors, and uncertainty.
State whether coefficients are domestic, total, import-adjusted, regional, national, or multi-region.
State limits involving capacity constraints, price response, substitution, inventories, and behavioral adjustment.
Document environmental or social extension sources, units, sector matching, and uncertainty.
Attach interpretation limits, validation status, uncertainty notes, and stop-use conditions to outputs.
